sourceDocuments.title: Molecular Basis of Antibiotic Inactivation
sourceDocuments.text: Bacterial resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics is primarily mediated by the expression of beta-lactamase enzymes that hydrolyze the four-membered beta-lactam ring structure.

studentDocument.title: Evolution of Microbial Resistance
studentDocument.text: Bacterial resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics is undoubtedly and primarily mediated by the robust expression of beta-lactamase enzymes that rapidly hydrolyze the four-membered beta-lactam ring structure.
